d:
A small, primate-like yordle with shaggy, mossy olive-green fur and a large, rounded nose. The eyes are wide, curious, and golden-yellow. The body is short and stout with three clawed fingers on each hand and a short, stubby olive-green tail. The outfit is minimal, consisting of a primitive leather strap across the chest and a stone club held in hand.
BODY COLOR: mossy olive-green
